body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Sharp unveiled ''SP700'' its new 4.3-inch T-DMB PMP during KES 2006 that is going to be available early next year. It has 4.3-inch wide LCD touch screen and audio/video playback for various files including education content. It also offers electronic dictionary and a built-in T-DMB receiver. You can add 30GB HDD and navigation feature (optional).
